selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: original segmented topology (node1 eth1/eth2 unaddressed, node2/node3 eth1 down)
selected_evidence.summary: Showed node1's eth1/eth2 as separate link-local-only interfaces, node2/node3 eth1 down, confirming two distinct segments prior to bridging

selected_evidence.requirement: SONiC pre-config cleanup (docker0 de-neutralized, reconcilers stopped) before bridging
selected_evidence.summary: Removed docker0's class-E IP and stopped interfaces-config/networking services on node1 per SONiC reference guidance

selected_evidence.requirement: Single L2 domain created with node1 forwarding (bridge), not routing
selected_evidence.summary: br0 created enslaving eth1+eth2 in forwarding state; node2/node3 addressed into shared 192.168.50.0/24; successful ping node2->node3 across the bridge; FDB shows per-port MAC learning; br0 carries no IP, confirming L2 forwarding not L3 routing
Installed and enabled antrieb-l2-bridge.service on node1 (recreates bridge at boot); added static eth1 stanzas to /etc/network/interfaces on node2 and node3

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline on all nodes
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, bridge forwarding state, SONiC container health on node1, and working cross-segment pings from node2/node3 before any restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; boot_id changed from 1f515f97... to 030ffac9...; post-restart bridge auto-recreated via systemd unit, all SONiC containers active, cross-node ping succeeded

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from 208921d8... to 7f2c37ac...; eth1 static IP persisted and ping to node3 succeeded post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from 384aa966... to 02f40386...; eth1 static IP persisted and ping to node2 succeeded post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Final verification: L2 domain and bridging behavior intact after all three sequential restarts
selected_evidence.summary: FDB shows node2's and node3's MACs learned on the correct respective bridge ports (eth1/eth2); br0 has no IP address, confirming node1 forwards frames transparently rather than routing
